Medicare’s physician payment cuts expose D.C.’s broken system—year after year of slashing reimbursements while practice costs soar. Taxpayers deserve better than this endless cycle of cuts and half-measures.

H.R. 879 proposes necessary structural changes to stabilize payments, but real reform requires auditing bloat like the $55 million Joint Autonomy Office bureaucracy that duplicates existing defense health programs. Every dollar wasted on redundant administrative layers is a dollar stolen from frontline caregivers.

The solution isn't just higher rates but ruthless efficiency - cut the fat, fund the mission.
